name: scholarship_audit_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_audit_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  campaign_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scholarship_campaigns(slug),
  batch_id TEXT REFERENCES scholarship_import_batches(id),
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('created','updated','previewed','applied','approved','published','unpublished','rollback','archived')),
  performed_by_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_sha256 TEXT,
  details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(datetime('now'))
)

name: scholarship_campaigns
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_campaigns (
  slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  school_year TEXT NOT NULL,
  semester TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_title TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_url TEXT,
  source_sha256 TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (
    status IN ('draft', 'validated', 'approved', 'published', 'archived')
  ),
  public_data_approved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (public_data_approved IN (0, 1)),
  public_scores_approved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (public_scores_approved IN (0, 1)),
  published_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, candidate_batch_id TEXT REFERENCES scholarship_import_batches(id), active_batch_id TEXT REFERENCES scholarship_import_batches(id),
  CHECK (status <> 'published' OR (public_data_approved = 1 AND published_at IS NOT NULL))
)

name: scholarship_import_batches
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_import_batches (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  campaign_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scholarship_campaigns(slug) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected_rows INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_rows >= 0),
  accepted_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (accepted_rows >= 0),
  rejected_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rejected_rows >= 0),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('previewed', 'applied', 'rejected')),
  performed_by_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
, mapping_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', payload_sha256 TEXT, approved_fields_json TEXT, approval_document_json TEXT, approved_by TEXT, approved_at TEXT, source_list_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified' CHECK (source_list_kind IN ('unspecified','eligibility','award_decision')), own_fields_json TEXT CHECK (own_fields_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(own_fields_json) AND json_type(own_fields_json)='array')))

name: scholarship_publication_audit
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_publication_audit (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  campaign_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scholarship_campaigns(slug) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('approved', 'published', 'unpublished', 'archived')),
  performed_by_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_sha256 TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

name: scholarship_recipients
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_recipients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  campaign_slug TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scholarship_campaigns(slug) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  source_row_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_row_number > 0),
  student_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(student_code) = 12),
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  full_name_search TEXT NOT NULL,
  class_name TEXT,
  major TEXT,
  award_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  gpa REAL CHECK (gpa IS NULL OR (gpa >= 0 AND gpa <= 4.5)),
  training_score REAL CHECK (training_score IS NULL OR (training_score >= 0 AND training_score <= 100)),
  selection_score REAL,
  source_row_sha256 TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  UNIQUE (campaign_slug, source_row_number)
)

name: scholarship_snapshot_rows
sql:
CREATE TABLE scholarship_snapshot_rows (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scholarship_import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  source_row_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_row_number > 0),
  source_identifier TEXT,
  student_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(student_code)=12 AND student_code NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  full_name_search TEXT NOT NULL,
  class_name TEXT,
  major TEXT,
  award_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  scores_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(scores_json)),
  source_row_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, scholarship_type TEXT, scholarship_rank TEXT, cohort TEXT, training_program TEXT, source_ordinal_json TEXT CHECK (source_ordinal_json IS NULL OR json_valid(source_ordinal_json)), private_rankings_json TEXT CHECK (private_rankings_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(private_rankings_json) AND json_type(private_rankings_json)='object')),
  UNIQUE(batch_id, source_row_number)
)

name: scholarship_transaction_guard
sql: CREATE TABLE scholarship_transaction_guard (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ok=1))

name: scholarship_snapshot_delete_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER scholarship_snapshot_delete_immutable BEFORE DELETE ON scholarship_snapshot_rows
  WHEN (SELECT status FROM scholarship_import_batches WHERE id=OLD.batch_id)='applied'
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SCHOLARSHIP_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE'); END

name: scholarship_snapshot_insert_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER scholarship_snapshot_insert_immutable BEFORE INSERT ON scholarship_snapshot_rows
  WHEN (SELECT status FROM scholarship_import_batches WHERE id=NEW.batch_id)='applied'
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SCHOLARSHIP_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE'); END

name: scholarship_snapshot_update_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER scholarship_snapshot_update_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON scholarship_snapshot_rows
  WHEN (SELECT status FROM scholarship_import_batches WHERE id=OLD.batch_id)='applied'
    OR (SELECT status FROM scholarship_import_batches WHERE id=NEW.batch_id)='applied'
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SCHOLARSHIP_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE'); END
